benchmark_warning: Previously inspected years; exploratory benchmark, not a fresh blind test.
selection: Lowest validation MAE among Ridge and Random Forest; no benchmark selection or tuning.
monthly: Original features and calendar-month-average baseline; two-month index lag.
weekly: Complete non-overlapping Monday–Sunday weeks; lags 2/3/4, three-week sum ending lag 2, lag 52, annual sine/cosine. Lag 52 is 364 days, not exact calendar-year matching.
weekly_baselines: seasonal weekly average smoothed over +/- 2.5/52 of annual cycle
purge: All fitted target period ends must be on/before first forecast's observation cutoff.
latency: Assumed seven-day availability allowance; historical data releases/revisions are not archived here.
